'''Secundus Ando''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EpisodeGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> located in the [[Secundus Ando system/Legends|Secundus Ando system]], a part of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was governed by ruling nests and was related to the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] species of<ref name="EGTW" /> the planet<ref name="CSWE Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. The Harch military leader [[Trench/Legends|Trench]], who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point between one and two [[Standard century/Legends|hundred years]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> hailed from Secundus Ando.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In the last century of the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Harch ruling nests were allied with the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], the group of worlds [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the Aqualish and being under Ando's influence, in its struggle against<ref name="EGTW" /> the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|30|Andosha II}}</ref> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], at some point by [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], Trench led a defense of Secundus Ando against Free Colonies' raiders.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Secundus Ando was introduced in the [[2010]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Secundus Ando [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square Q-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
